name: What do I need to prepare before a kitchen faucet installation appointment?

mainEntity.name: What do I need to prepare before a kitchen faucet installation appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your kitchen faucet installation appointment, it is helpful to clear out the cabinet under the sink to allow easy access for the installer. If you have purchased the new faucet, ensure it is on-site and readily accessible, along with all its components. Having these items prepared helps the process go smoothly and efficiently, allowing our Hometelligent Inc. technicians to begin work promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your appointment, clear the under-sink cabinet and have the new faucet and its components ready. This preparation helps Hometelligent Inc. technicians work efficiently.
